notes.helpers: Section -> SDK helper mapping: docs/technical/middleware-protocol.md, Appendix.
notes.patch_ops: Each patch is {op: set|delete|append, path, value?} applied in order to a deep copy of the named document. Plan-constraint paths start with the document name (capabilities, request or plan) from `base`; validate with base.plan.input_digest.
notes.scope_tokens: input_repeat {text,count} means text repeated count times; output null = not normalizable.
notes.capabilities_parsing: Compare legacy, features, transform ids (in order), mode, limits and max_retention_seconds of the parsed view; ok:false means parsing fails with reason.
notes.plan_constraints: valid:false cases must fail with invalid_plan. refresh_capabilities:true is asserted at runtime level: the next optimize after this plan triggers exactly one capabilities GET.
notes.failure_classification: input.body is raw response text; retry_after is the raw header value.
notes.breaker_sequences: Fresh breaker per sequence. success/failure: call allow(at_ms); if it returns true, record(result, at_ms). local: do not touch the breaker. expect.sent is allow()'s result, expect.state is the state after the step.
notes.budgets: replaced lists item keys; admitted/skipped are ids in input order; bypass payload_budget when items exist and none is admitted.
notes.endpoints: expect.capabilities_url is the resolved base plus caveman/v1/middleware/capabilities, or expect.error is the refusal code.
notes.runtime_scenarios: Runtime-level parity over a scripted transport. The runtime gets deadline_ms 5000 plus `options`. Each route answers from the step's `responses` queue, else a default: capabilities = base.capabilities with the scenario `capabilities` patches; optimize = base.plan with request_id and recovery.binding_id from the request and input_digest = sha256 of the sent body. A response is {route, status, json | body_text | body_base64 | plan | caps, headers}; plan/caps are patches on those defaults. `latency_ms` delays a route's answers during the step. Ops: optimize sends base.request (scope, adapter with id `adapter_id`, candidates from base.request.segments, manifest base.request.context_manifest, request_id, an owned binding) unless the step overrides scope (then no binding), adapter (null = none), candidates or manifest; concurrent_optimize runs `count` optimize calls at once; report reports the step's `optimization` ({status, reason}) with context `adapter`, else the last optimize result; decline calls decline(reason, adapter); preflight calls preflight(). expect.reason/status read the optimize result; expect.requests lists the routes requested during the step in order; expect.capabilities_gets counts capabilities requests; expect.warnings is the exact list of warn-once lines logged during the step; expect.event is a subset of the last decision event; expect.preflight compares status and reason.
